tools.name: request_signup
tools.title: Request Compabase Signup
tools.description: Start Compabase account setup for an email. Sends a magic link. After the user clicks it, poll check_signup with the returned setup_id until status is ready — then you receive an MCP key automatically. Do not ask the user to generate a key in the portal. No auth required.

email.description: User email to create or sign in to a Compabase account.

client.description: AI client, used to label the generated MCP key.

setup_id.description: Unique session ID for polling signup completion.

status.description: Current status of the setup session (e.g. pending).

expires_in_minutes.description: Minutes until this setup request expires.

tools.name: check_signup
tools.title: Check Compabase Signup Status
tools.description: Poll a request_signup session. When the user has confirmed email, returns mcp_key once and cursor_mcp_json to write to MCP config. Call every 3 seconds until status is ready, expired, or already_delivered. No auth required.

client.description: Optional client hint for the key name.

status.description: Setup session status: pending, ready, expired, already_delivered, or not_found.

key_name.description: Display name of the generated key.

cursor_mcp_json.description: Suggested MCP configuration snippet for Cursor / Claude Desktop.

poll_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before polling again if pending.

message.description: Status message or next step guidance.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.title: List Compabase Subscription Plans
tools.description: List Compabase billing plans and limits. No auth required. After sign-up, use upgrade_plan to get a Stripe Checkout URL.

plans.description: List of available billing plans with pricing and quotas.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.title: Search Polish Companies
tools.description: Search and filter Polish KRS companies (spółki). Compabase also holds the full CEIDG/JDG register; this tool does not browse JDG — those without a public contact email are hidden because of RODO. Default `fields=summary` returns a compact row (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/phone/website) — small enough for MCP clients. `fields=contacts_only` is name/NIP/KRS/city/email/phone/website only. `fields=full` returns every company_search column plus contacts and may exceed client size limits. Use for rankings, sector filters, city/county/region browsing, name search, or NIP/KRS lookup. When a PKD is mostly JDG, a sparse result includes a `hint` (full CEIDG is in the database; listing is RODO-gated). Do not call export_companies just to get a handful of emails or phones.

name.description: Company name fragment (case-insensitive). Matches display name and full KRS name; legal-form suffixes like 'sp. z o.o.' are ignored.

krs.description: KRS registry number (10 digits, zero-padded, e.g. '0000028860').

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, no dashes).

city.description: City name — KRS records use uppercase, e.g. 'WARSZAWA', 'POZNAŃ'.

pkd.description: Primary PKD code prefix, e.g. '46.90.Z' or '46'.

all_pkd.description: Match any PKD code in the company's activity list (not just primary).

legal_form.description: Legal form fragment, e.g. 'spółka z o.o.' or 'akcyjna'.

currency.description: Currency for monetary filters. Default: pln.

profit_operating_min.description: Minimum operating profit (PLN). Negative allowed. Omit if unused.

profit_operating_max.description: Maximum operating profit (PLN). Omit if unused.

is_active.description: true = active only, false = closed only. Omit for all.

has_email.description: true = only companies with email on record. Matching rows include contacts.email. Omit otherwise.

has_website.description: true = only companies with website on record. Matching rows include contacts.website. Omit otherwise.

year.description: Filter to companies whose latest financial_period_to falls within this calendar year (e.g. 2024). Use only for sector/ranking browse — omit when looking up a company by name, KRS, or NIP.

fields.description: Response size. Default summary (name, NIP, KRS, location, PKD, latest financials, email/phone/website). contacts_only: name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website. full: every company_search column plus contacts — often too large for MCP clients.

total.description: Estimated or exact total count of matches.

hint.description: Optional guidance regarding filters or CEIDG coverage.

tools.name: get_company
tools.title: Get Company Profile
tools.description: Get company registry profile and headline financials for one latest filed period (`financials.period_to` / `financial_period_to`): revenue, profit, costs, assets, PKD, address, plus contacts when on record. All money fields in this response are that same period — there is no nested summary from a different year. NIP lookup also returns a CEIDG/JDG firm when it has a public contact email (RODO). Does NOT include balance-sheet line items (cash, receivables, inventories). For those or earlier years, use get_financials.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, dashes optional).

contacts.description: Public contact details (email, phone, website) if available.

financials.description: Headline financials for latest filed period.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.title: Get Full Financial Statements
tools.description: Get full financial statement metrics per fiscal period — all entity_financial_metrics columns. Includes cash_and_equivalents, inventories, receivables, liabilities, equity, cost breakdown, revenue lines. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

financials.description: Historical financial statements with full balance sheet and P&L line items.

tools.name: get_company_people
tools.title: Get Company People & Management
tools.description: Get people associated with a company — management board, supervisory board, shareholders, proxies. Returns display names, role labels, and relationship types (management, supervisory, ownership, procuration). Identify by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown (legal-form suffix optional).

relationship_type.description: Filter: management, supervisory (rada nadzorcza), ownership, procuration. Omit for all.

people.description: List of associated persons (board, supervisory, shareholders, proxies).

tools.name: count_companies
tools.title: Count Polish Companies
tools.description: Count KRS companies matching given filters. Returns a single number — no company list. Does not count JDG in this tool (full CEIDG is in Compabase; listing is RODO-gated). Sparse or zero counts in JDG-dominated PKDs include a `hint`.

name.description: Company name fragment (case-insensitive). Matches display name and full KRS name; legal-form suffixes like 'sp. z o.o.' are ignored.

pkd.description: Primary PKD code prefix, e.g. '46.90.Z' or '46'.

all_pkd.description: Match any PKD code in the company's activity list (not just primary).

is_active.description: true = active only, false = closed only. Omit for all.

has_email.description: true = only companies with email on record. Omit otherwise.

has_website.description: true = only companies with website on record. Omit otherwise.

year.description: Filter to companies whose latest financial_period_to falls within this calendar year. Use only for sector/ranking browse — omit when looking up a company by name, KRS, or NIP.

count.description: Total count of KRS companies matching filters.

hint.description: Optional guidance regarding filters or CEIDG.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.title: Execute Read-Only SQL
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL SELECT query against the Compabase database. Use when dedicated tools are not enough (aggregations, joins, custom analysis).

query.description: A read-only SQL SELECT or WITH…SELECT statement.

rows.description: Result rows from the read-only query.

tools.name: get_company_rankings
tools.title: Get Company Sector Rankings
tools.description: Get a company's revenue rank positions within its industry (PKD), region (voivodeship), and all of Poland. Returns rows from company_financial_rankings — one row per scope (pkd_full, pkd_division, pkd_section, region, country). Use for questions like: where does company X rank in Poland / its industry / its region?

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits, dashes optional).

scope_type.description: Optional. Filter to a single scope. Omit to get all scopes.

rankings.description: Rankings by revenue, profit, and growth within sector and region.

tools.name: get_financial_stats
tools.title: Get Sector Financial Statistics
tools.description: Get precomputed aggregate financial statistics for a sector, region, PKD branch, or country. Returns median, p25/p75/p90, winsorized mean, mean, total, n_companies, min/max. Use for questions like: what is the median revenue / average profit / assets in industry X or region Y? Prefer median or winsor_mean over mean. cost_wages is PLN-only.

dimension_key.description: Key for the dimension, e.g. 'PL', 'G', '46', '46.90.Z', 'mazowieckie'. Prefix match applied.

metric.description: Financial metric. Omit to return all metrics.

stats.description: Aggregated sector benchmark statistics (averages, medians, percentiles).

tools.name: get_company_public_aid
tools.title: Get Public Aid (SUDOP)
tools.description: Get SUDOP public aid / grants for a company — full case list with amounts, grantor, measure, purpose. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

aid_records.description: Records of de minimis and state public aid granted to company.

tools.name: get_company_eu_funds
tools.title: Get EU Funds Projects
tools.description: Get European Funds (Fundusze Europejskie) projects for a company — official MFiPR lists, EU co-financing, programme and dates. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP. Cohesion/shared-management funds; not TED procurement, not FTS Commission grants, and not SUDOP state aid.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

projects.description: EU-funded projects and subsidies co-financed by European funds.

tools.name: get_company_procurement
tools.title: Get Public Procurement Contracts (FTS)
tools.description: Get European Commission FTS awards for a company — Horizon, LIFE, Erasmus and other direct/indirect-management grants. Keyed by NIP (VAT). Identify by name, KRS, or NIP. Not cohesion funds (get_company_fe) and not TED procurement.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

contracts.description: Public procurement tenders won by the company.

tools.name: get_company_public_tenders
tools.title: Get Public Procurement Bulletin (BZP)
tools.description: Get BZP public procurement data — full awards as contractor and notices as buyer, with award values. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

notices.description: Public procurement bulletin tender announcements and contract awards.

tools.name: get_company_energy_licenses
tools.title: Get Energy Regulatory Office Licenses (URE)
tools.description: Get URE energy concessions for a company — full list of electricity, gas, heat, and liquid fuels, with validity dates and pending applications. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

concessions.description: Energy regulator concessions and electricity/gas trade licenses.

tools.name: get_company_waste_registry
tools.title: Get Waste Management Registry (BDO)
tools.description: Get BDO waste and packaging register data — registration number, EUP site count, activity flags, and headquarters decisions with issue and validity dates. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

entries.description: BDO waste management registry registration and activity scopes.

tools.name: get_company_stock_market
tools.title: Get Warsaw Stock Exchange Data (GPW)
tools.description: Get Warsaw Stock Exchange listing for a company — ticker, ISIN, market (GPW main / NewConnect / GlobalConnect), last close and change, market cap, shares outstanding, EPS, P/E, dividend per share and yield. Quotes delayed ~15 minutes, in PLN. Snapshot plus a few recent daily bars — not full OHLCV history. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

profile.description: Listed company stock and market data.

tools.name: get_company_eu_tenders
tools.title: Get EU Tenders Daily (TED)
tools.description: Get TED EU-threshold public procurement — full awards as contractor and notices as buyer. Keyed by NIP. Identify company by name, KRS, or NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

tenders.description: High-value public procurement notices published on Tenders Electronic Daily.

tools.name: get_company_court_gazette
tools.title: Get Court and Commercial Gazette (MSiG)
tools.description: Get Court and Commercial Gazette (MSiG) notices for one company. Matched by KRS or NIP (creditor calls, dissolution, mergers, liquidation).

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

entries.description: Official announcements published in Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy.

tools.name: get_company_debt_registry
tools.title: Get National Debt Register (KRZ)
tools.description: Get KRZ insolvency / restructuring proceedings. KRS companies via company_krz; sole proprietors via CEIDG KRZ by NIP.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

proceedings.description: Insolvency, restructuring, and bankruptcy proceedings on record in KRZ.

tools.name: get_company_beneficiaries
tools.title: Get Ultimate Beneficial Owners (CRBR)
tools.description: Get CRBR beneficial owners for a KRS company. All names are returned (same as zarząd / wspólnicy). PESEL is never included (birth_year only). JDG are not in CRBR.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

krs.description: KRS registry number (required path for CRBR).

nip.description: NIP — used to resolve KRS when needed.

beneficiaries.description: Registered Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBO) from CRBR.

tools.name: get_company_articles
tools.title: Get News Mentions
tools.description: Get full text of the company's articles of association or statute (umowa spółki / statut) from RAR (Repozytorium Akt Rejestrowych). Use when the user asks about: share transfer consent, preemption rights, non-compete clauses, company duration, voting rights, special share classes, representation rules from the deed, or any clause in the founding document. Returns doc metadata + full extracted text. KRS companies only.

name.description: Company name when KRS/NIP is unknown.

nip.description: NIP — used to resolve KRS when needed.

doc_id.description: Optional: specific rar_doc_id. Omit for the latest articles / statute.

articles.description: Media mentions, press articles, and business news mentioning company.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.title: Get Account Usage & Quota
tools.description: Get current billing period usage and remaining quota — mcp_queries, api_requests, export_companies, ask_ai_credits, watchlist_companies. Includes limits and reset date.

usage.description: Monthly queries used, limit, and remaining quota.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Get Current Subscription Plan
tools.description: Get the user's active billing plan details — plan name, price, status, limits, prepaid credit balance, and billing period reset date.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.title: List Watchlist Companies
tools.description: List companies on the user's watchlist with company data (name, KRS, NIP, revenue, city). Supports pagination via limit/offset.

watchlist.description: List of tracked companies with monitored change status.

tools.name: add_to_watchlist
tools.title: Add Company to Watchlist
tools.description: Add a company to the user's watchlist. Identify by KRS (10-digit) or NIP (10-digit). Supports both KRS companies and CEIDG sole proprietorships (via NIP).

nip.description: NIP tax number (10 digits). Used for CEIDG if no KRS match.

tools.name: remove_from_watchlist
tools.title: Remove Company from Watchlist
tools.description: Remove a company from the user's watchlist. Identify by KRS or NIP.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.title: List REST API Keys
tools.description: List all active REST API keys (cb_…) for the user's account. Returns id, name, key_prefix, created_at, last_used_at.

api_keys.description: List of active REST API keys.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.title: Create REST API Key
tools.description: Create a new REST API key (cb_…). The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Human-readable label for the key (max 100 chars).
Label assigned to key.

tools.name: delete_api_key
tools.title: Revoke REST API Key
tools.description: Revoke (deactivate) a REST API key by its ID. The key stops working immediately.

key_id.description: UUID of the API key to revoke (from list_api_keys).

tools.name: list_mcp_keys
tools.title: List MCP Keys
tools.description: List all active MCP keys (mcpk_…) for the user's account. Returns id, name, key_prefix, created_at, last_used_at.

tools.name: create_mcp_key
tools.title: Create MCP Key
tools.description: Create a new MCP key (mcpk_…). The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Human-readable label for the key (max 100 chars).
Key name.

tools.name: delete_mcp_key
tools.title: Revoke MCP Key
tools.description: Revoke (deactivate) an MCP key by its ID. Cannot revoke the key currently in use. The key stops working immediately.

key_id.description: UUID of the MCP key to revoke (from list_mcp_keys).

tools.name: export_companies
tools.title: Export Companies to CSV
tools.description: Bulk file export of companies matching filters (CSV / XLSX / JSON). Up to 500 rows per call. Default `fields=contacts_only`: name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website — small enough to use in-chat. `fields=summary` adds location, PKD, latest revenue/profit. `fields=full` is the complete dump (change history, rankings, people, enrichments, CSV twins) and often exceeds MCP client limits. Consumes export quota only after the file is built successfully. For a short list of emails after search_companies, use search with fields=contacts_only instead.

name.description: Company name fragment (case-insensitive).

krs.description: KRS registry number (exports that one company).

county.description: County / powiat (lowercase). Same filter as search_companies / count_companies.

pkd.description: Primary PKD code (same as the browse PKD filter).

format.description: Export format (default: csv). Column set follows `fields` (contacts_only by default).

fields.description: Payload size. Default contacts_only (name, NIP, KRS, city, email, phone, website). summary adds county/region, PKD, latest revenue/profit. full is the complete profile dump — often too large for MCP clients; use only when asked for the full file.

download_url.description: Direct download URL for generated CSV file.

tools.name: upgrade_plan
tools.title: Upgrade Subscription Plan
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout session for a plan upgrade. Shows current plan and available upgrades. Pass plan_id ('pro' or 'scale') to get a checkout_url on checkout.stripe.com — open it in the browser for the user to pay. Do not send the user to the marketing pricing page.

plan_id.description: Target plan ID. Required to create a Stripe Checkout URL.

locale.description: UI locale for the success/cancel return URLs (default en).

currency.description: Checkout currency. Defaults from locale (pl → PLN, otherwise USD).

checkout_url.description: Stripe Checkout URL to complete subscription purchase.

tools.name: set_webhook_url
tools.title: Configure Webhook URL
tools.description: Configure, view, or remove webhook for watchlist event notifications. Events: watchlist.company_changed, watchlist.financials_updated, watchlist.company_removed_from_registry.

action.description: Action: 'get' to view config, 'set' to configure, 'delete' to remove.

url.description: HTTPS webhook endpoint URL (required for action=set).

events.description: Event types to subscribe to. Defaults to all available events.

tools.name: get_byok_keys
tools.title: Get Bring-Your-Own-Key Providers
tools.description: List configured Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) provider keys status. Shows which providers (openai, claude, gemini) have keys configured, with prefix and last-used date. Never returns the actual key.

tools.name: set_byok_key
tools.title: Set Bring-Your-Own-Key Provider
tools.description: Add or update a BYOK provider API key. Key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM). Requires paid plan (Pro+). Providers: openai (sk-…), claude (sk-ant-…), gemini (AIza… or AQ.…).

api_key.description: Raw API key for the provider.

tools.name: delete_byok_key
tools.title: Remove Bring-Your-Own-Key Provider
tools.description: Remove a configured BYOK provider key. After removal, the platform falls back to its own model access.

tools.name: add_watchlist_batch
tools.title: Batch Add Companies to Watchlist
tools.description: Add multiple companies to watchlist in one call. Provide an array of KRS/NIP identifiers (max 500). Resolves identifiers to companies, skips duplicates, respects plan limits.

identifiers.description: Array of KRS numbers (10 digits) or NIP numbers (10 digits).

tools.name: set_notification_preferences
tools.title: Set Notification Preferences
tools.description: Get or update email notification preferences for watchlist changes. When email_notifications=true, you will receive an email whenever a watched company's data changes (registry updates, new financial statements, deregistration, etc.).

email_notifications.description: Enable/disable email notifications for watchlist changes (required for 'set').

notification_email.description: Override email address for notifications. Omit to use account email.
